subject: biology
title: Lysosome
summary: The lysosome is the cell's cleanup and recycling sac - a membrane bubble filled with strong enzymes that break down waste, worn-out parts, and even invaders. Explore how it keeps the cell tidy and safe.

crossReferences.label: Golgi apparatus (Cell Biology)
crossReferences.note: The Golgi packages the enzymes that become lysosomes, so the cleanup sacs start life in the shipping center.

crossReferences.label: Vacuole (Cell Biology)
crossReferences.note: Like the lysosome, the vacuole is a membrane sac, but it mainly stores water and materials rather than digesting waste.

compareCandidate.label: Lysosome vs. vacuole
compareCandidate.description: Both are membrane sacs, but the lysosome is filled with digestive enzymes that break things down, while the vacuole mainly stores water, salts, and materials. Plant cells rely on one large vacuole for storage.

plainLanguageExplanation: The lysosome is a small sac full of powerful enzymes that digest things. Its job is to break down waste, old or damaged cell parts, and materials taken in from outside - even germs. It can also recycle the pieces, so the cell can use them again. The enzymes inside work best in the lysosome's special acidic environment, and the sac's membrane keeps these powerful digesters safely contained so they do not harm the rest of the cell. Think of the lysosome as the cell's recycling and cleanup crew.

keyFacts.value: Breaks down waste, old parts, and invaders with enzymes

keyFacts.label: Contents
keyFacts.value: Powerful digestive enzymes sealed in a membrane sac

keyFacts.label: Recycling
keyFacts.value: Pieces it breaks down can be reused by the cell

keyFacts.label: Found in
keyFacts.value: Animal cells have many; plant cells usually have fewer and larger ones

keyFacts.label: Safety
keyFacts.value: The sac's membrane keeps the strong enzymes from harming the cell

whyItMatters: Lysosomes keep the cell clean and recycle its materials. Without them, waste and broken parts would pile up, and the cell could not safely break down the things it takes in. Their work protects the cell's health.
didYouKnow: A single lysosome can digest and recycle a whole damaged organelle, breaking it into pieces the cell can use again.
